The '''Yantha system''' was a part of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was the origin point of the social group known as the [[Yanthan]]s.<ref name="Cestus" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Yantha [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square N-8.<ref name="TEA" />
